items: Use one authoritative versioned IdentityFact contract; do not duplicate identity constants in persona, self-knowledge, RealityLayer and fallbacks.
Separate AUTHORITATIVE_IDENTITY, OBSERVED_CAPABILITY, DERIVED_INTERNAL_STATE and NARRATIVE_RENDERING authority classes.
Require runtime receipts or STALE/UNKNOWN for capability/topology/model claims.
Use per-field freshness/authority rather than treating a mixed static/dynamic fact bag as ground truth.
Represent identity/capability/subjective-state values with explicit authority, provenance, freshness and rollback semantics.
Own-output-derived state transitions must be explicit lower-authority transformations, not silent truth updates.
Self-model projection and validation should consume the same authoritative typed state object.
Do not interpret output->internal-state feedback as externally grounded re-entry; distinguish self-generated proxy loops from sensor/event-grounded re-entry in GWT tests.
Do not globally broadcast large reality/identity blocks by default; compare selective task-scoped access against global injection for prompt leakage and interference.
Add lesion/rescue control for own-output proxy feedback when evaluating causal integration/emergence so circular reinforcement is not mistaken for emergent causal contribution.
Treat reduced confabulation from fact injection as grounding performance, not evidence of emergence/self-awareness.
Keep uncertain/current/stale capability alternatives as evidence-weighted possibilities until evidence selects or supersedes them.
Attach identity/capability/embodiment assertions to source/effect receipts and supersession lineage; graph activation must not upgrade assertion authority.
A ground-truth label is metadata only unless backed by authority/provenance/freshness evidence.
Persist identity once and materialize projections; capability/topology/model observations are timestamped evidence rows with freshness/supersession rather than synchronized declarations.
Add regressions for stale removed feature, wrong model version, denied live capability, identity hash mismatch and stale fallback after topology changes.
Run Ego state factorial ablation: telemetry-only vs event-grounded vs own-output proxy vs combined.
Add prompt-contamination tests comparing global Reality blocks, task-scoped retrieval and structured side-channel validation; include stale-validator-source injection.
Adopt authority-stratified self-model compilation: canonical identity + live observed capability/topology + derived subjective state, rather than duplicated prompt truths.

Historical design intent favored intrinsic self-knowledge and embodied metaphors, but implementation repeatedly accumulated stale mirrored facts; the later RealityLayer/Ego-Governor repair itself mixed dynamic hardware with static semantic constants and did not eliminate later self-model staleness. Preserve intent while replacing synchronization-by-editing with compiled projections and receipts.

reason: PF full tree/history denominator remains unfrozen; repair lineage overlaps prior mapped identity/state work and receives no duplicate hour credit.
